learning_outcomes.text: Recognize the role of design and innovation in a company.
Perform critical analyses of existing products.
Propose novel, customer-oriented solutions to satisfy certain functions or services.
Apply the most common techniques for industrial product development.

syllabus_topics: Evolution of Quality, Main Contributions and Fundamental Principles of Total Quality (Design, Manufacturing, Worker Life).
Red Method for Determining Functional Requirements.
The Functional Factor and other Design Factors.
Value Analysis (Economic Quantification of Functional Requirements).
assessment_rules: If the minimum grade required in any section is not met, the maximum grade for the subject will be 4.5 out of 10 (Fail). The minimum required grades are 5/10 for the long-answer test and assignments/reports, and 4/10 for oral presentations. Experimental work tests and reports are not recoverable.
